get.description: Hourly generation by source, load and net interchange, in average MW (Brasilia time).
Monthly energy, average and peak power and share by source (default: whole system).
Monthly energy exchanged between areas (positive: origin to destination), in MWh and MW.

``plant`` is given. Reasons overlap (see the contract): do not add them up.

get.description: Curtailment of one month per state. Same data as `/v1/curtailment/states/{state}`.

PLD per submarket. Hourly (max 31 days), daily, weekly average or monthly statistics.

`variant=shadow` is the CCEE "shadow" simulation, which is not the settlement price. It only
exists for the hourly series (2022 to 2024).

DEC (hours) and FEC (interruptions) per distributor for a year, worst first.

Annual values add the monthly indicators; a year in progress shows the months published so
far, and `months_with_data` says how many.
Monthly DEC and FEC of one distributor (consumer-weighted over its electrical sets).

Tariff flag of each month (green, yellow, red 1 and 2, water scarcity).

The additional charge (R$ per MWh) is added to the homologated tariff, before taxes; it is not
the bill.
Consumption in the regulated and free markets and the number of agents per class.

409.description: An account with this e-mail already exists.

put.description:
Turns the monthly e-mail (report and analyses) on or off for a signed-in member. Their
address is already verified, so there is no confirmation e-mail to click.

post.description:
Sends the monthly report (to subscribers and opted-in members) or the analyses e-mail (to
opted-in members). The recipients are mailed in the background; poll the list for progress.
